name: io.americanexpress.busybee.android.internal.BusyBeeIdlingResourceRegistration
description: BusyBee by American Express uses this Provider at app startup to register its idle-tracking helper only while automated tests are running. This lets tests wait for BusyBee work to finish.
disableEffect: Automated tests may not wait for BusyBee work to finish; ordinary app use is unaffected.
